title: Bump the opum-lore and opum-quest pins to 0.15.1 as ONE paired window (Article 3.4), with re-resolved baselines, CLAUDE.md managed block and schema export
description: Move the opum-lore and opum-quest federated pins to 0.15.0 as ONE window, never a half-move (Opum constitution Article 3.4, lore-cli LCLI-775). One PR carries both marketplace.json refs, both scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json entries (each skills/ subtree SHA re-read by ref at v0.15.0), the regenerated Codex marketplace, and the CLAUDE.md Quest block via the managed-block carve-out only. Dispatch gate: both @opum-ai/lore@0.15.0 and @opum-ai/quest@0.15.0 on npm latest, opum-cli-e2e TASK-179 post-move check clean, and a DEC-226 floor brief from the leader (pins and baselines are floor-class). Until then HELD: nothing starts. Rulings and detail are in the implementation note.

acceptanceCriteria.text: marketplace.json opum-lore AND opum-quest entries pin ref v0.15.0, and each plugin.json at its tag declares 0.15.0

scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json opum-lore and opum-quest skills/ subtree SHAs are each re-resolved independently by ref at v0.15.0 (lore not carried forward from a64e795e) and equal the tag skills/ tree
CLAUDE.md Quest block reads 0.15.0 via quest agents --update-instructions --target claude and no hand-written line changed
the lore schema export is produced under the published lore 0.15.0 binary, with the installed lore and quest versions printed
check manifests, Tracker integrity and lore check are green on the PR head, with both lore and quest installed by exact version 0.15.0

implementationNotes: 2026-11-02, widened to the PAIR on the leader's instruction (opum-doc ruling). Opum constitution Article 3.4 makes the lore and quest release a pair, so this one record names ONE window for both: marketplace.json opum-lore AND opum-quest refs, both scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json entries, and the CLAUDE.md:48 Quest block all move in the same PR, so a half-move cannot happen. Rulings: (1) lore's skills/ subtree SHA is RE-READ by ref at v0.15.0, not carried forward from a64e795e in the description above; quest's skills/ subtree SHA is resolved by ref at v0.15.0 too. (2) The CLAUDE.md:48 change is the managed-block carve-out (quest agents --update-instructions --target claude) and nothing else; no hand-written line moves. (3) Dispatch only once BOTH @opum-ai/lore@0.15.0 and @opum-ai/quest@0.15.0 are on npm latest AND opum-cli-e2e TASK-179 post-move check is clean. Approved work under the 2026-11-02 scope (3). DEC-226 floor-class (pins, baselines): it waits for a dispatch brief from the leader. Also regenerate .agents/plugins/marketplace.json from the Claude marketplace, and run lore agents --check. Supersedes the lore-only HELD wording in the description.

RETARGETED 2026-11-22 from 0.15.0 to 0.15.1 (0.15.0 never reached latest; DEC-282 (a6) operator verbatim "we can bump to 0.15.1 with the fixes"; DEC-290 (a4) lifts the fleet stop for this release work). The acceptance criteria below keep their 0.15.0 wording and are read as 0.15.1.
EVIDENCE at the PR head: (1) marketplace.json pins both v0.15.1; each plugin.json at its tag self-declares 0.15.1 (opum-lore, opum-quest, read raw at the tag). (2) Baselines re-resolved by me through the git-database API: lore tag object 0316a1c4 -> commit 9c6b3932 -> root 81a47fa3 -> skills a64e795e; quest tag object 0c35688b -> commit a880ca49 -> root 69242f93 -> skills 6df997f2 (unchanged from v0.14.1). lore-cli part 1 handshake figures matched; its +25 -2 claim was against v0.11.0, the real v0.14.1 to v0.15.1 SKILL.md change is one added line. (3) CLAUDE.md Quest block reads 0.15.1 through quest agents --update-instructions --target claude; the diff is that one managed line. The lore skill bridge .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md was regenerated with lore agents --target claude --force (it reported hand-edited because it was stale against 0.15.1; the diff is one generated line, the new cache command, as in a37efbf for 0.14.1). (4) lore schema export ran under lore 0.15.1 and produced no diff; installed versions printed: lore 0.15.1, quest 0.15.1 (npm install -g --ignore-scripts, latest read as 0.15.1 for both). (5) pending PR CI.
